title: console: a `type: "api"` action with `opensInNewTab` + `newTabUrl` opens no tab and POSTs to its target instead
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

The declared new-tab behaviour is ignored from both the record header and the more-menu.

## Reproduction

1. Action `export_tab` on `gapdata_item`: `type: "api"`, `opensInNewTab: true`, `newTabUrl: "https://example.com/export/{recordId}"` → click from the header and from the more-menu → no tab opens; network shows a POST to the target.

## Expected

The runner opens `newTabUrl` (interpolated) in a new tab as the spec documents, or the spec refuses the pair on api actions.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

Console action runner for api actions under `ui/`.

## Filing facts

- reach: Console UI, measured twice by the data gap-fill card.
- Business reason: A declared behaviour the runtime does not honour ("declared ⇒ enforced").
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:records`, p2.
- Dedupe: semantic search `action opensInNewTab newTabUrl ignored on api action no new tab` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 2 hits, both closed (#23077, #11842 — pair refine, not the runner).
- QA id: G8
